correctness.rationale: For every finite simple forest F and subgroup H of Aut(F), geometric invariance of barycentric coordinates is precisely constancy on H vertex orbits. Forbidden orbits have internal edges; the affine simplex map x_v=y_O/|O| establishes the PL homeomorphism with Ind(Q_H(F)), including the empty case. Rooted parent maps on the subdivided forest show each component-orbit quotient is a tree before deleting internally conflicting vertex orbits, so Q is a forest. If no isolate, deletion of the closed neighborhood of a leaf's neighbor suspends the residual independence complex; the empty graph convention gives S^-1 and handles S^0 correctly. The reduced fixed-point Lefschetz trace equals (-1)^e (including empty fixed space), while the unique rank-one ambient homology lies in degree d, giving integral degree (-1)^(e-d). No equivariant linear-sphere model is asserted.
